M9.falha_pt: A rigidez vem do modo de viver o veganismo, e não do princípio; o modo pode mudar sem abandonar a razão pelos animais

en.frase: I was vegan and started getting too radical, too rigid
formas: I got more and more rigid and saw the world only in black and white
I lost friends and family because of my radicalism
I didn't recognize myself anymore; I'd become a pain
en.falha: The rigidity comes from how veganism is lived, not from the principle; the way can change without giving up the reason concerning animals

motivos.O estereótipo de fora encontra a experiê: The outsider's stereotype meets the experience of someone who lived it from the inside
motivos.A ideia de pureza passa a ser vivida com: The idea of purity comes to be lived as rigidity
motivos.O pensamento em preto e branco afasta at: Black-and-white thinking drives away even those on the same side
motivos.Quem se reconhece no radicalismo passa a: Someone who sees themselves in the radicalism starts rejecting the whole group
motivos.Depois da rigidez, rejeita-se também o n: After the rigidity, the name gets rejected too
motivos.A própria experiência é apresentada como: The person's own experience is offered as proof
